accepts-suggestions: Let people who study this deck suggest fixes
accepts-suggestions-hint: You decide each one. Nothing changes a card until you accept it.
block-failed: Declined, but the member could not be blocked
block-title: Decline everything from this member and block them?
dialog-hint: Write the text as it should read. Only the author sees it, and nothing changes until they accept.
empty-hint: When someone suggests a fix to a card, it appears here for you to accept or decline.
off-note: Suggestions are off for this deck. Open ones stay here until you decide them.
refused-blocked: You cannot suggest to this deck.
refused-deck-cap: This deck has too many open suggestions
refused-invalid: Check the text of the card and try again.
refused-member-cap: You have too many open suggestions on this deck.
refused-no-change: This changes nothing. Edit the text first.
refused-off: The author is not taking suggestions on this deck.
refused-own-deck: You cannot suggest to your own deck.
refused-too-new: Your account must be a week old before you can suggest fixes.
suggest-fix-card: Suggest a fix to the author for {{front}}
